purpose: REQUIRED-CONFIGURATION SPECIFICATION for the credentialless release publication path (GitHub OIDC Trusted Publishing) and for the CI-issued cryptographic attestation of release artifacts. This file is NOT evidence of configuration and NOT evidence of publication: it states the security boundary and the exact external configuration that MUST exist before any publication may ever run. It deliberately separates repository structural evidence from externally verified live configuration.

repository_structural_evidence.note: What this repository version-controls and its non-privileged CI proves: the fail-closed privileged release workflow, the release evidence builder/verifier tooling, the reproducible-build/SBOM/manifest evidence bundle, and green non-privileged validation jobs.
repository_structural_evidence.live_publication_dependency: external PyPI trusted-publisher configuration and an explicitly authorized release run

external_live_configuration_evidence.note: Facts verifiable ONLY from live GitHub/PyPI configuration and an authorized release execution. The repository never fabricates them.
external_live_configuration_evidence.note_details: PyPI Trusted Publishing for the dbf-anonymizer project has NOT been externally configured or live-verified, and the GitHub Environment 'pypi' has NOT been created. The publication job is fail-closed and cannot run until the authoritative gate repository variable is set AND the GitHub Environment 'pypi' exists in the workflow AND the PyPI project owner completes the Pending Trusted Publisher configuration with the exact publisher identity (see publication.publisher_identity).

publication.ref_guard: refs/heads/main or refs/tags/* only, verified before any checkout; every other ref is refused
publication.fail_closed_note: The publication job condition is vars.DBF_PYPI_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_ENABLED == 'true'. While the variable is unset the job cannot run and nothing is published; the gate deliberately follows the fail-closed pattern established for the trusted VFP9 runner lane (REQ-P7-006).
publication.pre_publication_verification: The publication job re-runs tools/verify_release_evidence.py against the downloaded evidence bundle and refuses to publish on any mismatch (fail-closed).

publisher_identity.note: The REQUIRED identity the future externally configured PyPI Trusted Publisher must match EXACTLY. The publication job is bound to the GitHub Environment 'pypi' (see .github/workflows/dbf-release-publish.yml, job publish-pypi). This identity is a specification, NOT proof of configuration: neither the GitHub Environment nor the PyPI Trusted Publisher exists yet (see evidence_classes.external_live_configuration_evidence).

external_configuration_required: The GitHub Environment 'pypi' must exist in the privileged workflow (job publish-pypi) and SHOULD carry deployment protection (manual approval) before the first publication.

The PyPI project owner must configure the dbf-anonymizer project's Pending Trusted Publisher on PyPI with the EXACT publisher identity (owner PeterPirog, repository DBF_Anonymizer, workflow filename dbf-release-publish.yml, environment pypi) before any publication can succeed.
The repository owner must set the repository variable DBF_PYPI_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_ENABLED to 'true' only after BOTH the GitHub Environment and the PyPI-side configuration are live.

attestation.note: GitHub artifact attestations are cryptographically verifiable, CI-issued build provenance statements signed through GitHub's OIDC/Sigstore infrastructure. No private signing key exists: no signing key is created, stored, or read anywhere in this repository, and the attestation job can never execute for pull_request events.

integrity.manifest_digest_binding: The SHA-256 of the FINAL exact manifest bytes is written to the sidecar after the manifest reaches its final form (no recursive self-hash inside the JSON). The verifier checks the trusted digest BEFORE trusting any artifact hash recorded inside the manifest. A coherent rewrite of the manifest and its sidecar is still rejected whenever the expected digest comes from an external trusted source.
integrity.pr_validation_provides: structural verification only: the non-privileged pull_request workflow holds no id-token, no attestations and no publication authority, so it can never produce a signed attestation
integrity.note: Artifact hashes feed the release manifest; the manifest bytes are bound by their SHA-256 sidecar; the privileged CI attestation covers the manifest, its digest and the SBOM so the evidence chain is artifact hashes -> manifest -> manifest SHA-256 -> CI-issued attestation.

source_binding.cleanliness_check: git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all must be empty before any release evidence build; no --allow-dirty escape hatch exists
source_binding.source_export: the recorded commit is exported via git archive into a task-owned temp tree and BOTH independent builds run from that exported committed snapshot, never from the mutable working tree
source_binding.note: The manifest records the exact commit SHA, the cleanliness result and the source-export protocol.

invariants: no publication credential, token, or id-token authority may ever be exposed to pull_request execution
the privileged release workflow must never contain a pull_request, pull_request_target or workflow_run trigger
any job holding id-token: write or attestations: write must live exclusively in the privileged release workflow and must remain SHA-pinned and minimally permissioned
the publication job is fail-closed: it runs only from an authorized release context (release published or a main/tag dispatch) AND only when the authoritative gate repository variable equals 'true'
the repository never claims PyPI Trusted Publishing is configured; that platform fact stays external and must be verified live before publication

no private signing key exists; cryptographic authenticity comes from CI-issued GitHub artifact attestations over the artifacts, the manifest, its digest sidecar and the SBOM, and integrity comes from the SHA-256 hashed evidence manifest plus its digest sidecar
release evidence must be built from an exactly exported clean commit object, never from a mutable working tree
